blocks.text: Don't worry — this simple guide will get you there easily.
After installing the VPN service you can use it yourself and share it with others. Create separate users in the server settings and set flexible limits. One VPN server is enough for 10–50 people!

We do not sell VPN as a service. Our monetization is hosting referral programs that we recommend via our links. Buying VPS servers through our link does not make the service more expensive for you. From each of your purchases we get tips of 0.5-1$. That lets us earn and keep developing Pathology, add, update, and even create new protocols.
Paid services sell VPN for 200-300 rubles/month per person, using one VPS server for dozens of clients and limiting their internet speed. Now you decide who gets access and which limits to apply!
